ConnectionStrings.//: Development only, pointing at the Postgres container from 04-Infrastructure.md section 2. This file is not copied into the production image. Production supplies ConnectionStrings__Default as an environment variable.

DataProtection.//: Local path, created at startup if missing. Keeping it out of bin/ means a rebuild does not sign you out.

Seeding.//: Development only. This file is not copied into the production image, and there is no default for these values anywhere else.

Notifications.//: Still off locally: there is no SMTP transport here, and the drainer marks undeliverable entries Skipped and clears email_body -- which destroys invitation and password-reset links that cannot be regenerated. Turn it on only against a real or captured transport.

DueDateScanner.//: Off locally as well. It writes real notification rows on a timer against the development database, which makes 'why do I have twelve reminders' a debugging session rather than a feature. Turn it on deliberately, and only in one process.
